items.t: Its board sub-area code is UNVERIFIED, and it is not asserted here as an official City of Delta neighbourhood name. Feed streets in the research snapshot include Harrow Avenue, Seashell Drive, 3 Avenue, 66a Street, Centennial Parkway and Market Avenue.

Municipality and plan: Tsawwassen, City of Delta, under the Delta Official Community Plan 2024, "Housing Our Future", Bylaw No. 8400, adopted July 8, 2024 — a single consolidated plan with NO lettered schedules; there is no Tsawwassen area-plan schedule in Bylaw 8400 (the former Tsawwassen Area Plan was Schedule D.1 under the previous OCP, Bylaw No. 3950 (1985)), and farm land is designated "Agriculture (A)" (s. 1.5.1).
Market statistics: NONE are quoted for this ground.

Where the condo stock concentrates: inside Southlands, the Century Group master-planned community at Market Avenue (developer sales centre recorded at 101 – 6388 Market Avenue) — its flats are the sub-area's verified strata product. The waterfront streets themselves are detached houses.

The ground itself: Boundary Bay Regional Park and Centennial Beach, 570 Boundary Bay Rd, Delta (Metro Vancouver) — Dyke Trail, Savannah and Raptor trails, Cammidge House; Metro Vancouver identifies the park as an internationally recognized Important Bird Area and a critical rest stop for birds on the Pacific Flyway, and notes most of Centennial Beach is closed to dogs, with signed marker posts showing where dogs are prohibited.
Catchments for other Boundary Beach addresses: UNVERIFIED — SD37 also publishes Tsawwassen Area catchment boundary maps (elementary and secondary, updated October 2017).

Transit: TransLink route 601 runs Boundary Bay trips via 12 Avenue, Boundary Bay Road, 3 Avenue and 67 Street to 1A Avenue, continuing via South Delta Exchange and Ladner Exchange to Bridgeport Station (Canada Line).

Health care: Delta Hospital, 5800 Mountain View Blvd, Delta, in Ladner (Fraser Health), is the nearest hospital, and Fraser Health lists a South Delta After-Hours Urgent and Primary Care Centre serving Tsawwassen at 1826 – 4949 Canoe Pass Way.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect condo buyers in Boundary Beach Guide

items.t: Delta zoning — number CONTESTED, flagged, not settled: City pages cite "Delta Zoning Bylaw No. Zoning is confirmed parcel by parcel on the City zoning maps in either case.

Hazard Development Permit Area SD3 (Boundary Bay Foreshore and the Southlands): — named for this exact ground in OCP Bylaw No. 8400, Appendix B: no building with the underside of a wooden floor system or the top of a concrete slab for habitable areas lower than 2.9 metres Geodetic Survey of Canada datum, minimum land surface elevation around construction 2.3 metres GSC datum, and no building within 7.5 metres of the natural boundary of a tidal area. Whether a specific Boundary Beach parcel sits inside SD3 is a parcel-level check: UNVERIFIED for any individual lot.

Dike and SSMUH: the Boundary Bay shore sits behind the Boundary Bay dike; Delta is the diking authority and operates and maintains over 63 kilometres of flood protection infrastructure, 31 drainage pump stations and approximately 538 kilometres of drainage infrastructure. Delta's SSMUH zoning allows up to four units on all single-detached and duplex lots, with City support for accessory dwelling units such as coach houses, garden suites and secondary suites.

blocks.text: Good to know about Boundary Beach Guide

items.t: The hazard permit area is named for this ground. SD3 is literally titled "Boundary Bay Foreshore and the Southlands" in OCP Appendix B — the 2.9 m / 2.3 m / 7.5 m figures are not generic Delta rules applied here; they were written for this shoreline and this development area.

"Flats" is the developer's word for condos at Southlands. Century Group calls its apartment product "flats" (garden flats, District Flats, High Street Flats) — a buyer searching only "condos" misses phases in developer and presale records.

The Granary's courtyard neighbour is a brewery. The Four Winds brewery and gastropub encloses the north end of The Granary's garden courtyard — an amenity and a noise/activity fact in the same structure, worth a site visit at pub hours before writing on a courtyard-facing flat.

The feed's edge is not the neighbourhood's edge. This page's Boundary Beach feed bundles three different products — beachfront detached houses, Southlands strata phases and the 3 Avenue gated ranchers — under one sub-area label; compare each listing against its own street and peers, not against the page.

Two live-page defects are on the record for this guide page (Jerry's list). (1) The Parks section gives Centennial Beach's address as "300 Boundary Bay Road" — the official Metro Vancouver address is 570 Boundary Bay Rd. (2) In the "Boundary Beach questions" FAQ, "How do I see current Boundary Beach listings?" appears with NO answer — it is answered only in the separate footer FAQ block.

Most of Centennial Beach is closed to dogs. Metro Vancouver states most of the beach is dog-prohibited, with signed marker posts showing where — a daily-life fact for dog owners that listing copy for "steps to the beach" homes does not mention.
Health care: Delta Hospital, 5800 Mountain View Blvd in Ladner, is the nearest hospital; Fraser Health lists a South Delta After-Hours Urgent and Primary Care Centre at 1826 – 4949 Canoe Pass Way.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect townhome buyers in Boundary Beach

items.t: Form B diligence (Monterra is strata): Strata Property Act s. 59 — the Form B states the lot's monthly strata fees, amounts owing, approved special levies still payable, the CRF balance and an insurance summary, with the rules, current budget, any Rental Disclosure Statement and the most recent depreciation report attached; provided within 7 days, maximum $35 plus up to 25 cents per page.

Dike and flood system: the Boundary Bay shore sits behind the Boundary Bay dike; Delta is the diking authority and operates and maintains over 63 kilometres of flood protection infrastructure, 31 drainage pump stations and approximately 538 kilometres of drainage infrastructure.

ALR rule (Southlands edge): ALR residences cannot be stratified (ALC Bulletin 09 s.6; Strata Property Act s.239; Agricultural Land Community Act s.21(1) as cited in the program record) — Southlands product sits on former farm-designated ground under City approvals, and no ALR parcel is townhouse stock.

blocks.text: Good to know about Boundary Beach

items.t: The feed's edge is not the neighbourhood's edge. This page's feed includes Southlands and 3 Avenue product labelled Boundary Beach, so a listing should be compared against its own street and sub-area peers, not against beachfront cards on the same page.
One Southlands project is counted in two programs, by form, once each.

The 2.9 m number governs this shore. SD3 sets the habitable floor at 2.9 metres GSC datum with a 2.3 m minimum land elevation and a 7.5 m tidal setback — the diligence numbers behind any "beachfront" marketing on this coast.

The dike trail is a working dike. Boundary Bay Regional Park's Dyke Trail runs on the dike system Delta maintains as flood protection (over 63 km of flood protection infrastructure city-wide) — recreation on top of infrastructure, which is why foreshore work is permitted, not casual.

Most of Centennial Beach is closed to dogs. Metro Vancouver notes signed marker posts show where dogs are prohibited in the park — a daily-life fact for a rancher-community buyer steps from the beach.

The old area-plan name is gone from the current OCP. The Tsawwassen Area Plan was Schedule D.1 under the previous OCP, Bylaw No. 3950; the current OCP, Bylaw No. 8400 (2024), consolidated the former area plans into a single Land Use Plan with no lettered schedules. Any source quoting a "Schedule D.1 of Bylaw 8400" is stating a conflation.

Delta's zoning bylaw number is contested in the sources — do not quote one. City material carries competing citations (7600, 2017 vs "8400, 2025"); what governs a purchase in practice is the parcel's own zone (CD201 on Monterra's data sheet) and its registered strata bylaws.

blocks.text: Lots and land in Boundary Beach
Fee-simple lots

items.t: The beachfront streets themselves (Centennial Parkway, 66 Street) are detached houses on fee-simple lots, ranging in the page's own framing from older beach cottages to large newer houses, some with beach access or views across the bay — page framing, cited as such. Fee-simple is the default tenure here: no strata corporation, no Form B, no strata fees on a fee-simple lot.
Subdivision potential runs off the parcel's own zone; zoning is parcel by parcel on the City zoning maps.

blocks.text: Bare-land strata as its own form

items.t: A bare-land strata lot IS strata tenure: the buyer owns the strata lot (essentially the building lot itself) and the house on it, and Form B, strata fees for common property, and registered bylaws apply to the lot. It is NOT a fee-simple lot. Monterra is freehold strata of the conventional (non-bare-land) plan form per its data sheet.

blocks.text: ALR, servicing, assemblies

items.t: ALR vs non-ALR split: no area-wide split is published in the research and none is stated. Any individual parcel's ALR status is checked on the ALC maps by PID or civic address.

Serviced vs unserviced: no parcel-level servicing statement for Boundary Beach lots is documented in the research — UNCONFIRMED per parcel. For any unserviced parcel: GWELLS for wells, and Fraser Health's onsite-sewerage position (a home not connected to a community sewer needs an onsite system complying with the Sewerage System Regulation, designed and installed by an Authorized Person).

blocks.text: Local rules that affect land buyers in Boundary Beach

items.t: Subdivision / servicing — process documented, number not asserted: a Development and Subdivision Standards Bylaw No. 8288, 2024 (repealing No. 506, confirmed with the City for the specific parcel — instead of asserting the number as governing.

Dyke / flood frame: the shore sits behind the Boundary Bay dike; Delta is the diking authority (over 63 km of flood protection infrastructure, 31 drainage pump stations, ~538 km of drainage infrastructure). Foreshore tenure: the Province owns nearly all saltwater foreshore; tenure is by lease or licence only via FrontCounter BC, and private moorage is held under General Permission or Specific Permission — a "private dock" is not land the seller owns.

ALR block (farm-edge parcels, where ALR ground is met): ALR residences cannot be stratified (ALC Bulletin 09 s. 6; Strata Property Act s. 239; ALCA s. 21(1)); subdivision within the ALR requires ALC approval. Residence caps: principal ≤500 m², suite within principal only, additional residence 90 m² (≤40 ha) / 186 m² (>40 ha). Farm class — three-tier, in full: $2,500 on 0.8–4 ha; $2,500 + 5% of value over 4 ha; $10,000 under 0.8 ha; applications by October 31. A flat "$2,500+" statement is an ERROR.

Bare-land strata / strata block (applies to any strata lot here, Monterra included): Form B (SPA s. 59) discloses monthly fees, amounts owed, approved levies still payable, CRF balance and insurance summary, with rules, budget and most recent depreciation report attached; provided within 7 days, max $35 + 25¢/page. Depreciation reports every 5 years for strata corporations with 5+ lots since July 1, 2024, non-deferrable. CRF minimum contribution 10% of the operating budget since November 1, 2023. Rental-restriction bylaws VOID since November 24, 2022 (long-term; short-term may still be restricted) — Monterra's data-sheet "Rentals Not Allowed" line is VOID for long-term rentals. Only 55+ age bylaws are valid (SPA ss. 123.1/123.2 + Regulation 7.01, incl. the May 1, 2023 exemptions); a "45+" listing line is NOT a valid BC age bylaw, and Monterra's "Adult Oriented" site-influence line is not an age bylaw — no 55+ bylaw is verified for Monterra. Fee-simple contrast: a fee-simple lot carries none of this.

Speculation / vacancy + prohibition: SVT taxable areas include the City of Delta; reserve/treaty/self-governing lands are excluded; the Vancouver Empty Homes Tax (3%) is Vancouver ONLY. SVT payable on a specific parcel: UNCONFIRMED.

faq.q: Who can help me buy or sell in Boundary Beach?
faq.a: Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, works across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. Call or text 604-928-1361 or use the contact form on this site.

faq.q: How do I find out which school serves an address in Boundary Beach?
faq.a: School catchments are set by address, so use the school district's catchment locator with the exact address. Catchment lines change, so check before you write an offer.

faq.q: Do I need a home inspection when buying in Boundary Beach?
faq.a: It is strongly recommended. Make the offer subject to an inspection so a qualified inspector can look at the roof, structure, drainage, electrical and heating before you remove conditions.

faq.q: Can Jared show me homes in Boundary Beach?
faq.a: Yes. Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, books private showings across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. Call or text 604-928-1361, or use the contact form on this site.

faq.q: Is there a condo on the beach at Boundary Beach?

faq.a: One 3-storey woodframe Century Group project at Red Barn Boulevard and Market Avenue in Southlands, recorded on its presale record as 16 single-level garden flats plus 19 walk-up townhomes around a garden courtyard, with underground parking and the Four Winds brewery/gastropub at the courtyard's north end. Completion on that record: TBA — so GST and the REDMA 7-day rescission frame apply to a developer purchase, and per-unit status must be confirmed before relying on either.

faq.q: Is Monterra a townhouse complex or duplexes?
faq.a: Listings disagree — sub-type Duplex in one, Townhouse in another, for the same gated community at 6505 3 Avenue (built 1992/1993 across the listings read). It is attached strata product either way and is not an apartment condo; the strata plan and Form B settle the form for a specific lot.

UNCONFIRMED. Its rancher format reads as downsizer product, but no source read states an age bylaw for it; the only lawful form is a 55+ bylaw under SPA ss. 123.1/123.2, and the registered bylaws on the Form B package decide it.

faq.q: Can I rent out a Southlands flat or a Monterra unit long-term?
faq.a: Yes as a matter of provincial law — strata rental-restriction bylaws have been void since November 24, 2022. Short-term rentals can still be restricted by bylaw; read the registered bylaws.

faq.q: Is there a townhouse on the Boundary Beach waterfront?
Is Monterra a townhouse complex or a duplex community?
faq.a: Listings conflict — Townhouse in the MLS data sheet (Title: Freehold Strata, plan LMS469), Duplex in another listing for a half-duplex rancher-style home.

faq.q: Can I rent out a Monterra home?
faq.a: Long-term, yes in law: the data sheet's "Rentals Not Allowed" line is a strata rental-restriction bylaw, void province-wide since Nov 24, 2022. Short-term rentals can still be restricted by bylaw — read the registered bylaws.
